flavor.text: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.
Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.

abilities.name: Inner Focus
abilities.description: The Pokémon's intense focus prevents it from flinching or being affected by Intimidate.

children.name: Urshifu
children.condition: Train in the Tower of Darkness or Train in the Tower of Waters or Use Scroll of Darkness
